top3.headline: LangChain's internal agents run on five shared building blocks
top3.whyItMatters: Identity is the hard part, so decide which agent actions run as people and which as bots.

top3.headline: GPU rents outpace depreciation, with H200 up 143%
top3.whyItMatters: Token demand since April keeps compute expensive, so budget AI capacity for high rates.

top3.headline: Power equipment is becoming a choke point for AI buildouts
top3.whyItMatters: US electrical gear capacity fell 9% as prices rose 69%, so check power lead times early.

items.title: LangChain shares how it runs three internal agents in Slack
items.takeaway: Sales, coding and content agents share five parts: Slack, per-tool identity, two-tier memory, sandboxes, scheduled runs.
items.soWhat: Plan identity per tool early; Chase calls it the trickiest part of running company agents.

related.name: Add identity to Managed Deep Agents

items.title: Perplexity Computer adds /impeccable, a skill that fixes AI-made interfaces
items.takeaway: Open-source skill by Paul Bakaus checks layout, type, contrast and accessibility; free through Oct 31.
items.soWhat: Design review is becoming an agent skill, so expect AI-built interfaces to get a quality pass.

items.title: US capacity to make electrical equipment shrank 9% since 2019
items.takeaway: Per a16z, semiconductor capacity rose 77% over the same period while electrical equipment prices rose 69%.
items.soWhat: Power gear, not chips, may limit AI buildouts, so check equipment lead times in your plans.

items.title: GPU rents run far ahead of six-year depreciation schedules
items.takeaway: Per a16z: H200 +143%, B200 +111%, H100 +54%, A100 +9%; most of the gap opened after April.
items.soWhat: Token demand is holding GPU prices up, so don't plan on compute getting cheaper soon.

related.name: a16z on GPU rental rates this year

hotOnX.text: A security researcher says OpenAI banned their account over local reverse-engineering of a Samsung TV.
hotOnX.note: Builders worry about bans for legitimate security work; no OpenAI statement was found.

hotOnX.text: GPUs still rent ahead of a six-year depreciation schedule, H200 +143%, with most of the gap after April.
hotOnX.note: It challenges the idea that older AI chips lose value fast.

hotOnX.text: US electrical equipment capacity is down 9% since 2019 while prices are up 69%.
hotOnX.note: It points to power, not just chips, as a key limit on the AI buildout.

hotOnX.text: Perplexity adds /impeccable to Computer so users can build interfaces that don't look like AI slop.
hotOnX.note: Generic-looking AI interfaces are a common complaint among builders.
